name: Fiona MacLeod
bio:
Fiona MacLeod's motorsport journey began not in the grandstands, but in her father's garage, tinkering with engines from a young age. This hands-on experience fueled her passion, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a junior race engineer and demonstrating a keen eye for detail and a knack for strategic decision-making. 

Her approach to the sporting director role is characterized by a data-driven methodology combined with a deep understanding of the human element within a racing team. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. What sets Fiona apart is her ability to balance technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills, allowing her to effectively communicate complex information and motivate those around her. She joined Iron Lynx after a successful spell at a smaller team where she oversaw their unexpected championship challenge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail during race weekends
physical.description: Fiona has a determined look and a smattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct team briefings standing up, believing it promotes more active participation.
